rows.note: Use this as the usual spoken noun for someone who has broken the law.

example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zuk1 dou3 go3 faan6 jan4 laa3

rows.note: Use this for someone who has offended or upset another person, rather than for a legal criminal.

example.english: I don’t want to be an offender, so I watch what I say.
example.traditional: 我唔想做個得罪人嘅人，講嘢會留意啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zou6 go3 dak1 zeoi6 jan4 ge3 jan4 gong2 je5 wui5 lau4 ji3 di1
